title: Dunce's Fine-Tuned
description: A vanilla+ modpack that still feels like Minecraft. You may need a decent PC to run this modpack.
body:
![The words 'Fine-Tuned' made of glass with a gradient going from purple to orange.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/227d5726b56f95af2ab1796191a587809dd7ef30.png)

Fine-Tuned is a Vanilla+ modpack dedicated to keeping the Minecraft feel while still improving the game.

# Features

### Inventory Improvements
- Many items are now animated
- Inventory items now have particle effects
- [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks)
- Each enchanting book, painting, and trimmed armor piece has unique textures in their inventory.
- Items now stay inside crafting tables, enchanting tables, and anvils whenever you leave their respective menus.

### Graphical Improvements
- Automatically comes with BSL, Complementary, and Solas Shaders pre-installed. (BSL is the default, and my personal choice)
- Many blocks now have emissive textures
- New first-person animations
- [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) and addons
- New icons on tooltips and menus
- Many optimization mods
- Better explosion vfx
- More particle effects
- Chunks now smoothly load in rather than instantly appearing
- [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) player skin options in the mod menu, including enchanted and emissive pixels on player skins.
- Rain is now replaced by sandstorms in deserts

### Audio Improvements
- More ambient sounds
- Sound physics (echoes, muffled sounds, etc.)
- Unique SFX for basically everything, including holding, breaking, placing, and moving items.
- Unique rain SFX for certain materials

### Gameplay Improvements
- Improved F3 Menu
- New button on the main menu to quickly join the last played world/server.
- Improved terrain generation
- Improved elytra controls, allowing you to do cool tricks in the air.
- Fast leaf decay
- The ability to favorite worlds
- Adds the option to play on a borderless fullscreen window, letting you do stuff on other monitors or applications.

...and many other small tweaks!

The majority of these things can be **fine-tuned** to your liking in the mod menu.

*gallery images are downscaled to conform to Modrinth's image size limits.
